title: Haav underway
description: What to watch while the boat is running. Source: haav-telemetry/dashboards/underway.json (generated).

panels.title: Pixhawk link
panels.description: Autopilot HEARTBEAT seen in the last 5 s (haav-mavlink). NO EXPORTER = haav-mavlink not running or LTE down.

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Pixhawk power-module voltage. Thresholds assume the 12S pack: red < 3.5 V/cell (42 V), orange < 3.7 V/cell (44.4 V).

panels.title: Speed
panels.description: GPS ground speed. Race pace: 2 mi in 45 min = 2.7 mph minimum.

panels.title: GPS sats (3D fix)
panels.description: Satellites in view; 0 / NO FIX if the fix is worse than 3D.

panels.title: Sensors
panels.description: Number of enabled Pixhawk sensors reporting unhealthy (SYS_STATUS). Check Pixhawk diagnostics for which.

panels.title: LTE: last sample
panels.description: Age of the newest Pi sample in Grafana Cloud. Climbs during LTE drops; the 8 h WAL backfills afterwards.

panels.title: Pi 5 V rail
panels.description: vcgencmd under-voltage: 5 V rail below ~4.63 V. SAGGED EARLIER = happened since boot (e.g. under motor load).

panels.title: Pi SoC temp
panels.description: Pi 4 soft-throttles at 80 °C, hard-throttles at 85 °C.

panels.title: SD card
panels.description: Free space on /. READ-ONLY = kernel remounted the card after errors (sudden power loss); logging has stopped.

panels.title: LTE data (time range)
panels.description: rx + tx through wwan0 over the dashboard's time range. Set the range to the run to see its data cost.

panels.title: LTE burn rate (1h)
panels.description: Bytes per hour on wwan0 over the last hour. Budget: 10-20 MB/hr against the ~500 MB SIM.

panels.title: Track
panels.description: Pixhawk fused position over the time range; arrow points the way the boat is heading.

panels.title: Status timeline
panels.description: Gaps = no data (LTE down, Pi off, or Pixhawk link lost).

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Bands: Pi 4 soft limit 80 °C, hard throttle 85 °C.

panels.title: LTE throughput (wwan0)
panels.description: rx up, tx down. Mostly Alloy remote_write; flat zero = modem up but nothing flowing.

panels.title: Control link
panels.description: Raw 0-255 signal values. Watch for a downward trend as the boat moves away.

panels.title: Events & warnings
panels.description: haav-mavlink events (Pixhawk STATUSTEXT, mode/arm changes, waypoints, link up/down) and WARNING+ from kernel, ModemManager, tailscaled, alloy.

panels.title: CPU usage by mode
panels.description: iowait spikes usually mean a slow/dying SD card.

panels.title: EKF variance
panels.description: >0.8 is bad, >1 fails EKF checks.

panels.title: Motor outputs
panels.description: PWM per named output (HAAV_MAV_SERVO_OUTPUTS). Diverging port/stbd = turning.
